observations: Three manual hydraulic pallet jacks are shown in a row.
The jacks have yellow painted metal forks and black handles.
The forks show significant surface rust and wear.
The hydraulic rams and foot pedals are visible.
A watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A video showing the jack being pumped and the forks being raised and lowered.

risks.risk: The forks may be cracked or structurally compromised.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fork tips and the underside of the forks.

risks.risk: The foot pedals may be worn or the handles may be cracked.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the foot pedal and the handle joints.

proof_requests: Video of the jack being operated to show the hydraulic function.
Close-up photos of the fork tips and the underside of the forks.
Close-up photos of the foot pedal and the handle joints.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
